title: Ulmoidol, an unusual nortriterpenoid from Eucommia ulmoides Oliv. Leaves prevents neuroinflammation by targeting the PU.1 transcriptional signaling pathway.
authors: Han, Rui; Yuan, Tian; Yang, Zhi; Zhang, Qiang; Wang, Wei-Wei; Lin, Li-Bin; Zhu, Ming-Qiang; Gao, Jin-Ming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Ulmoidol通过靶向PU.1转录因子抑制其与DNA结合来缓解神经炎症，虽涉及TF-DNA互作和分子对接，但核心是药物抗炎机制，非TF-DNA结合建模方法研究。
abstract: Chronic neuroinflammation is closely associated with the development of neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease (AD). In the current study, 13 anti-neuroinflammatory compounds were isolated from Eucommia ulmoides Oliv. leaves. Among these compounds, trans-sinapaldehyde (6), 3',4',5,7-tetrahydroxy-3-methylflavone (7), and amarusine A (13) were isolated from E. ulmoides leaves for the first time. The ursane-type C(29)-triterpenoid, ulmoidol (ULM, 9), significantly inhibited the production of proinflammatory mediators and reduced the expression of inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) and cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2). Moreover, ULM inhibited the cluster of differentiation 14 (CD14)/Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) signaling pathway and consequently limited the activation of nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) and mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signaling pathways. Notably, electrophoretic mobility shift assay (EMSA) and molecular docking analyses indicated that ULM could prevent PU box binding-1 (PU.1) from binding to DNA, suggesting that PU.1 might be a potential ULM target. In conclusion, ULM alleviates neuroinflammatory responses in microglia, which could be partly explained by its targeting of PU.1 and the resulting suppression of the TLR4/MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathways. These results suggested that ULM may have therapeutic potential as an agent for treating neuroinflammation-related neurodegenerative diseases.
abstract_zh: 慢性神经炎症与神经退行性疾病（包括阿尔茨海默病（AD））的发生密切相关。在本研究中，从杜仲（Eucommia ulmoides Oliv.）叶片中分离出13种抗神经炎症化合物。其中，反式芥子醛（trans-sinapaldehyde, 6）、3',4',5,7-四羟基-3-甲基黄酮（3',4',5,7-tetrahydroxy-3-methylflavone, 7）和苦木素A（amarusine A, 13）为首次从杜仲叶片中分离得到。乌苏烷型C(29)-三萜类化合物杜仲醇（ulmoidol, ULM, 9）显著抑制促炎介质的产生，并降低诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）和环氧合酶-2（COX-2）的表达。此外，ULM抑制分化簇14（CD14）/Toll样受体4（TLR4）信号通路，从而限制核因子κB（NF-kappaB）和丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）信号通路的激活。值得注意的是，电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）和分子对接分析表明，ULM可阻止PU盒结合蛋白-1（PU.1）与DNA结合，提示PU.1可能是ULM的潜在靶点。总之，ULM缓解小胶质细胞中的神经炎症反应，其部分机制可能归因于其靶向PU.1并由此抑制TLR4/MAPK/NF-kappaB信号通路。这些结果表明，ULM可能具有作为治疗神经炎症相关神经退行性疾病药物的治疗潜力。
